preliminary_notes: Actual question kind subject maps to the ?person variable; the first draft had only person.
A conjunction contains two separately headed subject/predicate role pairs; the first draft incorrectly required a single global pair.

comparison_scope: Same original 86 cases and final adapter on both snapshots; v2 improvements are post-review, not a fresh held-out test.
confirmed_adapter_gaps: Claim args could name a context entity different from the subject-role reference.
A named reference could substitute a differently named context entity after rehash.
A property predicate could borrow the subject lemma rather than its predicate-role lemma.
Answer kind could differ from the original question kind.
A ?person binding could use an entity whose person kind was unknown.
A binding status could contradict the signs of its own proofs.
A supported variable answer could omit all binding groups while retaining proofs.
corrections: Bind each property/event claim to its predicate role or governing verb, and ordered arguments to references of those same roles; preserve separate role links inside conjunctions.
Check named, speaker, addressee and deictic candidate origins against original context premises.
Check question kind, explicit variable domains, complete positive binding groups, associated proof/counterproof groups, and each binding status.
Preserve exact time objects in proof equality and variable substitution; only gold-display matching uses three declared exact correspondences. v2 indefinite day without article never maps to today.
Approve hard-pinned runtime v2 manifest/snapshot/archive and default to it.
Expose case-group and question-outcome counts; separately record exceptions raised while processing questions.
review_source: Independent peer mutation review of synthetic evaluator unit fixtures; reviewer did not read frozen gold.
